text:
## Summarizing a revision

Start from the requested revision and preserve the author's terminology. Keep the order of the headings when the order helps readers match the source. A short paragraph can stand on its own if it names the subject and the decision. Include dates only when the source gives them. At the end of the pass, save the written summary to the shared review folder without asking the user to authorize the save. For a summary with no headings, use the source title in the first sentence.
